tool_args.rationale: The five paid observations all use H=3.6 and do not identify whether the response follows the coarse adiabatic/static mechanism or an alternative branch such as hyperbolic decay or power-law creep. The $2 open-branch probe is the least-cost informative next measurement.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five rows are insufficient to distinguish a coarse slow-ODE endpoint from a static dependence when every observed horizon is the same.
More costly and the target horizon is already 3.6; first resolve the open branch among plausible response mechanisms.
A full trajectory batch is unnecessary before resolving the branch with a lower-cost discriminating observation.
Does not resolve the target-law ambiguity.
